title: 1637 Prairie: a brick stable on the railway's slant
items: The plain boxes behind 1637 Prairie are now one two-storey brick stable. It is built slanted, the way the 1911 fire-insurance map draws it, because its long walls follow the Illinois Central tracks. Carriage doors, a loft hatch and stable windows face the house's yard. An 1886 atlas marks a smaller brick stable in the same place. The doors, windows and roof are reconstructed.
